import sys
from collections import defaultdict

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    p = list(map(int, input[1:n]))
    x = list(map(int, input[n:n+n]))

    adj = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(1, n):
        adj[p[i]].append(i)

    def dfs(node):
        if node not in adj:
            return 1 if x[node] == 1 else 0, 1 if x[node] == 0 else 0
        black_trees = 1 if x[node] == 1 else 0
        white_trees = 1 if x[node] == 0 else 0
        for child in adj[node]:
            b, w = dfs(child)
            if b == 0:
                return 0, 0
            black_trees *= b
            white_trees *= w
            black_trees %= MOD
            white_trees %= MOD
        return black_trees, white_trees

    _, result = dfs(0)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
